title: Luxurious Slow Cooked Australian Duck Stew
description: A sweet and savory stew featuring tender duck and root vegetables, slow cooked in an earthenware bowl to perfection. This dish is perfect for a cozy night in.
instructions: Season the duck legs with salt and pepper.
Heat the duck fat in the earthenware bowl over medium heat.
Sear the duck legs until browned on all sides, then set aside.
Add the chopped onions to the bowl and cook until they are softened and caramelized.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the bowl, cooking for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the browned duck legs, thyme sprigs, and red wine to the bowl, covering with a lid.
Transfer the bowl to the oven and cook at 300 degrees Fahrenheit for 2 hours.
Remove the bowl from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
